//: Nothing here is compiled: `tsc` only type-checks, and node runs both the `.mjs` and the `.ts` files as they are. `allowJs`/`checkJs` are what make `pnpm typecheck` read the JSDoc of the `.mjs` scripts (same arrangement as in packages/config); `allowImportingTsExtensions` and `erasableSyntaxOnly` are what keep the `.ts` ones runnable by node's type stripping, which needs the extension in the specifier and refuses any syntax that is more than a type annotation (enum, namespace, parameter property).
